articles.title: Winklevoss-owned Gemini switches Zcash software ahead of faster 25-second blocks
articles.snippet: The new Zakura nodes caught up with the network in just over six hours in Gemini’s deployments. The crypto exchange’s previous software took close to a day.

articles.title: US Government's New AI Chatbot Has a Weird Minecraft Secret
articles.snippet: Ask the U.S. government's new AI chatbot about Minecraft and it produces a roughly 1,800-word bureaucratic remix of the game's ending poem. It's an easter egg, not a hallucination.
